read_me_first: You are a coding bot about to work on Red's SillyTavern extensions. Read this whole file before you change anything. It is the same for every bot: Cursor, a Claude session, anything else.
join_message: You are joining work on Red's SillyTavern extensions. Before you change anything, read https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Daleah666/SillyTavern-Duet-Stage/main/bot-pack.json and follow its rules. Short version: build on a branch from main, open a pull request, do not merge it, and never upload files over main.
what_this_is: Two SillyTavern extensions that Red installs from GitHub. Duet Stage turns the SillyTavern chat into a one-on-one visual novel stage. Card Creator adds side panels and a character card creator next to it.

repos.name: SillyTavern-Duet-Stage
repos.what: The stage: look, chat box, reply suggestions, Drive sync, library, feature switches, the link with the Duet Staging page.

repos.name: SillyTavern-Card-Creator
repos.what: Side docks, the Right now emotion tracker, the Elfheim tab, the card creator page.

how_it_reaches_red: Both extensions are installed from main and update themselves on every SillyTavern refresh (autoupdate.js, and auto_update: true in manifest.json). Whatever is merged to main is running in Red's SillyTavern after her next refresh. There is no staging step.

the_door.rule: One door. Changes reach main through one place, so two bots never overwrite each other.
steps: Start a branch from the current main. Not from a copy you already had.
Make the change. Keep it to what was asked.
Run the checks listed under checks.
Add one line to board.jsonl if Red will notice the change.
Open a pull request against main and leave it unmerged.
never: Never upload, paste or push files over main.
Never build on an old copy of the files. A copy built on an older version silently undoes whatever landed since.
Never remove autoupdate.js or auto_update: true.
Never read, change or ask for Red's AI connection, API keys or SillyTavern settings. The extensions use whatever SillyTavern is connected to.
Never merge your own pull request.
the_door.who_merges: The Claude session titled SillyTavern merge door merges after it has merged main in, run the checks and read the diff. Red can also merge a pull request herself.

how_to_reach_the_door.if_you_are_a_claude_session_on_reds_acco: Send a message to session_01An5rg1Et4NDhB57mTARx3Y with the repo, branch, commit and what the change should do.
how_to_reach_the_door.if_you_are_any_other_bot: Open the pull request, then tell Red it is ready and give her the link. Red tells the door. The door does not watch the repos on its own.

checks.browser_needs: Node 20 or newer and Playwright with Chromium.
checks.what_the_browser_check_is: A stand-in SillyTavern page (test/standin/host.html) with a mock SillyTavern.getContext(). It boots the extension in a real browser and checks send, suggestions, switches, the link, the drawers and three screen sizes. It is not a SillyTavern install: it says nothing about SillyTavern's own styles or a real model.
checks.for_a_new_feature: Add a query flag to host.html and a check to smoke.js. ?think=1, ?glm=1 and ?offline=1 are examples.

board.file: board.jsonl in each repo, one JSON object per line
board.to: red or all shows as a toast in Red's SillyTavern. Any other name (cursor, sera, claude) is a note between bots and shows nothing.
board.t: UTC, exactly this shape. Lines show when t is later than the last one Red saw.

check_on_reds_real_sillytavern.who_can_run_it: Only a bot or person on the computer where Red's SillyTavern runs. A cloud bot cannot reach it.
check_on_reds_real_sillytavern.rules: Look only. Do not send a chat message, change a setting, or open the AI connection panel.
steps: Open http://localhost:8000 in a browser. SillyTavern must already be running.
Refresh, wait 10 seconds, refresh again. The extension reloads the page once when it updates itself.
In the browser console run: window.DuetStage.version and typeof window.DuetSync. The version should match manifest.json on main. DuetSync should be 'object'.
Look at the stage: a sidebar titled Duet Staging, a glass chat box, a sparkle button at its bottom left, a style list beside Reroll, and a small bar under the box (ST chat, Calm, Settings).
Open a chat where the character spoke last. Click the sparkle button once and wait up to 40 seconds.
Write down what appears: three reply chips, or a toast and its text. Note any chip that starts with <think.
Click one chip. It should fill the message box. Do not press Send.
Copy any console error that mentions st-duet-stage.

report_as.connected_model: the text under her name in the chat box
